title: 1000 Players Simulate Civilization: Rich & Poor
overview: Over 1,000 players are split between two vastly different environments: a resource-rich paradise and a harsh, barren island. What begins as an asymmetrical social experiment in resource management rapidly turns into a gripping geopolitical epic.  Spanning 10 days of intense, unscripted gameplay with proximity voice chat, the participants establish economies, draft treaties, form underground cartels, and build complex political factions. As systemic inequality and greed strain diplomatic relations, trade breakdowns inevitably ignite a devastating full-scale global war. Documented through Ish’s omniscient narration and visual storytelling, the video delivers a sprawling narrative on human behavior, power structures, and societal collapse.
